summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in react-native-drago-callkit@1.0.0
details: No install-time execution, no credential or environment reads, no outbound network beacons to attacker-controlled destinations, and no obfuscated or fetched-then-executed payloads were observed in this package version. No lifecycle scripts performing fetch-and-execute, no silent-relay of caller-supplied data to a hardcoded third-party endpoint, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms are present.
